columns.name: Standard Payment Terms
columns.definition: Reporting entity's standard (i.e. default) payment terms offered in their contracts to their small business suppliers at the start of the reporting period (in calendar days). It doesn't account for any supply chain finance arrangements.

columns.name: Changes to Standard Payment Terms
columns.definition: Changes to the standard (i.e. default) payment terms offered by the reporting entity over the 6 month reporting period (in calendar days). If no change to the standard payment terms, the same number is repeated.

columns.name: Details of Changes to Standard Payment Terms
columns.definition: Explanation of any changes to the standard (i.e. default) payment terms offered by the reporting entity over the 6 month reporting period.

columns.name: Shortest Standard Payment Terms
columns.definition: Shortest standard (i.e. default) payment terms offered in contracts by the reporting entity at the start of the 6 month reporting period to their small business suppliers (in calendar days).

columns.name: Change to Shortest Standard Payment Terms
columns.definition: Changes to the shortest standard payment terms offered by the reporting entity over the 6 month reporting period (in calendar days).

columns.name: Details of Changes to Shortest Payment Terms
columns.definition: Explanation of any changes to the shortest standard payment terms offered by the reporting entity during the 6 month reporting period.

columns.name: Longest Standard Payment Terms
columns.definition: Longest standard (i.e. default) payment terms offered by the reporting entity at the start of the 6 month reporting period to their small business suppliers (in calendar days).

columns.name: Changes to Longest Payment Terms
columns.definition: Changes to the longest standard payment terms offered by the reporting entity over the 6 month reporting period (in calendar days).

columns.name: Details of Changes to Longest Payment Terms
columns.definition: Explanation of any changes to the longest standard payment terms offered by the reporting entity during the 6 month reporting period (in calendar days).

columns.name: Percentage of Number Invoices Paid Within 20 Days
columns.definition: The total NUMBER of small business invoices paid (within 20 calendar days) divided by the total NUMBER of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Number Invoices Paid Between 21 and 30 Days
columns.definition: The total NUMBER of small business invoices paid (between 21 - 30 calendar days) divided by the total NUMBER of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Number Invoices Paid Between 31 and 60 Days
columns.definition: The total NUMBER of small business invoices paid (between 31 - 60 calendar days) divided by the total NUMBER of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Number Invoices Paid Between 61 and 90 Days
columns.definition: The total NUMBER of small business invoices paid (between 61 - 90 calendar days) divided by the total NUMBER of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Number Invoices Paid Between 91 and 120 Days
columns.definition: The total NUMBER of small business invoices paid (between 91 - 120 calendar days) divided by the total NUMBER of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Number Invoices Paid in More Than 120 Days
columns.definition: The total NUMBER of small business invoices paid (over 120 calendar days) divided by the total NUMBER of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Value Invoices Paid Within 20 Days
columns.definition: The total VALUE of small business invoices paid (within 20 calendar days) divided by the total VALUE of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Value Invoices Paid Between 21 and 30 Days
columns.definition: The total VALUE of small business invoices paid (between 21 - 30 calendar days) divided by the total VALUE of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Value Invoices Paid Between 31 and 60 Days
columns.definition: The total VALUE of small business invoices paid (between 31 - 60 calendar days) divided by the total VALUE of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Value Invoices Paid Between 61 and 90 Days
columns.definition: The total VALUE of small business invoices paid (between 61 - 90 calendar days) divided by the total VALUE of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Value Invoices Paid Between 91 and 120 Days
columns.definition: The total VALUE of small business invoices paid (between 91 - 120 calendar days) divided by the total VALUE of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Percentage of Value Invoices Paid in More Than 120 Days
columns.definition: The total VALUE of small business invoices paid (over 120 calendar days) divided by the total VALUE of all small business invoices paid over the reporting period, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: Invoice Practices and Arrangements
columns.definition: Details of any practices or arrangements used by the reporting entity during the reporting period for the receiving or paying of small business invoices.

columns.name: Practices and Arrangements for Lodging Tenders
columns.definition: Details of any practices or arrangements used by reporting entity during the reporting period that required small business suppliers to pay an amount, such as a subscription or membership fee, to participate in the reporting entity's procurement processes, including to lodge a tender.

columns.name: Practices and Arrangements to Accept Invoices
columns.definition: Details of any practices or arrangements used by entity during the reporting period requiring small business suppliers to pay an amount, such as a subscription or membership fee, for the reporting entity to accept an invoice issued by the small business supplier.

columns.name: Percentage of Total Value of Small Business Procurement
columns.definition: The total value of all procurement by the reporting entity during the reporting period that was from small business suppliers. Expressed as a percentage of all procurement by the reporting entity.

columns.name: Supply Chain Finance Arrangements
columns.definition: A description of any supply chain finance arrangements that are provided or used by the reporting entity for small business suppliers.

columns.name: Percentage of Total Value Supply Chain Finance Arrangements
columns.definition: The total value of small business invoices where these supply chain finance arrangements were used. Expressed as a percentage of all small business invoices paid by the reporting entity.

columns.name: Percentage of Total Number of Supply Chain Finance Arrangements
columns.definition: The total number of small business invoices where these supply chain finance arrangements were used. Expressed as a percentage of all small busines invoices paid by the reporting entity.

columns.name: Benefits of Supply Chain Finance Arrangements
columns.definition: Details of any benefits, including commissions or other payments, received by the reporting entity from the provider of any supply chain finance arrangements.

columns.name: Requirement to Use Supply Chain Finance
columns.definition: Statement on whether small business suppliers were required to agree to use supply chain finance arrangements to participate in the reporting entity's procurement process or to receive payments for invoices during the reporting period.

columns.name: Detail of Change in Income Year
columns.definition: The new start date of the reporting entity’s income year (accounting period). Only used if there has been a change.

columns.name: Detail of Change in Business Name
columns.definition: Information about any changes to the reporting entity’s business name that occurred during the reporting period.

columns.name: Detail Entities Below Reporting Threshold
columns.definition: Information about any changes to any member entities whose income was below $10 million in the two most recent income years. These entities will cease to be a reporting entity.

columns.definition: Any additional written information to provide context or explanation in relation to the information provided in the report.
